#######################################################################
# Nine-loop T^2 near-collinear terms of the three-point form factor remainder function
# at leading-logarithmic order (coefficient of T^2 Log[T]^8), in closed form, in the
# format of "T2terms8loops.txt" (Dixon, Gurdogan, McLeod, Wilhelm, arXiv:2204.11901):
#    R^(9) = T^2 * sum_k Log[T]^k RT2[9,k] + O(T^4),
#    RT2[L,k] = -(1+y)^2/y * RT2A[L,k] + (1+y) * RT2B[L,k] + RT2C[L,k],   y = S^2,
# with u = 1/(1+S^2+T^2), v = T^2/(1+T^2), w = 1/(1+T^2)/(1+(1+T^2)/S^2).
# Iy(a1,...,an) = G(a1,...,an; y) are Goncharov polylogarithms with indices in {0,-1},
# G(0,...,0;y) = Log[y]^n/n!;  z2 = zeta[2], z3 = zeta[3], ...
# Obtained from the finite-coupling form factor OPE (Sever, Tumanov, Wilhelm) by an exact
# fit of the series through y^908; the identical procedure reproduces the published
# RT2A/B/C[L,L-1] for L = 3..8 exactly.  Maximum weights: A 9, B 7, C 8.
#######################################################################
